name: scribe
description: Write markdown documents beside an agent co-author. The co-author panel is a real Kiro Crew chat session scoped to the document, so the agent brings your memory, knowledge library, and codebase context to the draft — and can edit the document while you watch it update.
author: pevu
highlights: Rich markdown editor with autosave — versions snapshot on demand
AI co-author chat scoped to the document — a full Kiro Crew session with your memory and tools
Highlight a passage to anchor a comment; the co-author addresses it and marks it for your review
Documents are artifacts, optionally backed by a real .md file on disk — portable, diffable, readable by any editor
useCases: Draft a design doc or notes in markdown while a document-scoped agent supplies implementation details from your codebase and research from your memory.
configuration: Enable the app, create a document, and start a co-author session from the panel — documents are stored as markdown artifacts, optionally backed by a file path you choose.
